decisions: 1.both.1: added MenuService.replaceIf, which reopens the tracked menu instead of updating it in place, allowing title and size changes; WikiMenu uses it for list/loot transitions and records the replacement epoch so back navigation still works.
1.both.2: parseWiki now resets the whole map to shown with no icon when show or icon is unusable, including an icon map that fails item-reference parsing.
1.both.3: added a test loading the shipped worlds.yml and all seven shipped loot files to pin their order, and changed the no-world-settings test to insert beta before alpha and assert id order.
1.both.4: the head-icon test now asserts the adapter was asked for player_head with the configured head data.
The replacement tests cover same-row title/size changes, differing row counts with the back button at slot 48, and returning to the preserved list page.
